{{Short description|Football competition}}
The '''2023 Copa Libertadores final stages''' were played from 1 August to 4 November 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/calendario-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana-2023/|title=Calendario de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2023|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=24 April 2023|access-date=24 April 2023}}</ref> A total of 16 teams competed in the final stages to decide the champions of the [[2023 Copa Libertadores]],<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Manual-de-Clubes-CL-2023-1.pdf|title=CONMEBOL Libertadores / Manual de Clubes 2023|publisher=CONMEBOL|access-date=7 February 2023|language=es}}</ref> with the final played in [[Rio de Janeiro]], Brazil at [[Maracanã Stadium|Estádio do Maracanã]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://conmebollibertadores.com/cards/NewsReaderWeb/la-final-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-2023-se-jugara-en-el-maracana|title=La Final de la CONMEBOL Libertadores 2023 se jugará en el Maracaná|trans-title=The 2023 CONMEBOL Libertadores Final will be played at the Maracaná|publisher=CONMEBOL Libertadores|date=8 March 2023|language=es}}</ref>

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
Starting from the round of 16, the teams play a [[single-elimination tournament]] with the following rules:<ref name="regulations"/>
*In the round of 16, quarter-finals and semi-finals, each tie is played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis, with the higher-seeded team hosting the second leg (Regulations Article 2.2.3.2). If tied on aggregate, [[Away goals rule|away goals]] will not be used, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] will not be played, and a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] will be used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.3).
*The final is played as a single match at a venue pre-selected by CONMEBOL, with the higher-seeded team designated as the "home" team for administrative purposes (Regulations Article 2.2.3.5). If tied after regulation, 30 minutes of [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] will be played. If still tied after extra time, a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] will be used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.4).<section end=Format />

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the round of 16 was held on 5 July 2023, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−04:00|UTC−4]]) at the CONMEBOL Convention Center in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref name="R16 draw">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/fecha-y-horario-para-los-sorteos-de-los-octavos-de-final/|title=Fecha y horario para los sorteos de los Octavos de Final|trans-title=Date and time for the Round of 16 draws|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=21 June 2023|access-date=21 June 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/los-enfrentamientos-de-octavos-en-la-conmebol-libertadores-2023/|title=Los enfrentamientos de Octavos en la CONMEBOL Libertadores 2023|trans-title=The Round of 16 matchups in the 2023 CONMEBOL Libertadores|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=5 July 2023|access-date=5 July 2023}}</ref> For the round of 16, the 16 teams were drawn into eight ties (A–H) between a group winner (Pot 1) and a group runner-up (Pot 2), with the group winners hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association or the same group could be drawn into the same tie (Regulations Article 2.2.3.2).<ref name="regulations"/><section end=Draw />

==Quarter-finals==
[[File:Recibimiento Copa Libertadores Racing.jpg|thumb|250x250px|[[Racing Club de Avellaneda|Racing]] vs. [[Boca Juniors]], Quarter-finals match (30 August 2023)]]

===Summary===
The first legs were played on 22–24 August, and the second legs were played on 29–31 August 2023.<ref name="QF fixture">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/el-fixture-para-los-cuartos-de-final-en-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana/|title=Fixture para los Cuartos de Final|trans-title=Fixture for the Quarter-finals|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=11 August 2023|access-date=11 August 2023}}</ref><ref name="QF fixture pdf">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/Fixture_CONMEBOL-Libertadores_CUARTOS-DE-FINAL.pdf|title=PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS - CUARTOS DE FINAL {{!}} Departamento de Competiciones y Operaciones {{!}} Versión de 11/08/2023|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=11 August 2023|access-date=11 August 2023}}</ref>

==Semi-finals==
[[File:PALMEIRAS X BOCA JUNIORS - COPA LIBERTADORES 2023 (53286428161).jpg|thumb|250x250px|[[Sociedade Esportiva Palmeiras|Palmeiras]] vs. [[Boca Juniors]], Semi-finals match (5 October 2023)]]

===Summary===
